# Cooperative Agent Mesh alpha.17

Alpha.17 lets multiple participants coordinate around one verified state.

`aria mesh create <request.json> --json` requires:

- distinct producer, critic, and human participants;
- content-addressed member artifacts;
- at least two distinct provider-bridge identities;
- challenge-and-reconcile coordination;
- human resolution of material disagreement;
- explicit prohibition of self-approval and shared authority.

The mesh never asserts consensus merely because participants are connected.
Material disagreement blocks closure. Evidence may compose; authority may not.
